method: Saturday provisional: baseline fair line vs Bookmaker 5:43 pm PT capture, ESPN injury feed (Sat 11:08 am PT) and reviewed expert/media intake. Andy approved the pick in chat.

pitch.text: The baseline fair line puts the Chargers at +0.2 at home, a 3.2-point Jets edge at +3, the largest model-vs-market gap on the Week 11 slate.
The Chargers secondary is thin: S Kendall Williamson and CB Rodney Shelley are out, LB Daiyan Henley is out, and CBs Tarheeb Still and Isas Waxter are questionable.
The Action Network opener was Chargers -3.5; Bookmaker (5:43 pm) and BetOnline (5:46 pm) both sit at -3, with Bookmaker paying -103 on the Jets.

pushback.text: Geno Smith (ankle) was cleared to start per RotoWire, but the Jets are without WR Omar Cooper Jr. and WR Isaiah Williams; the passing game leans on Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell.
75% of BetMGM money is on the Chargers -3 (John Ewing, Fri). A move to LAC -3.5 would cost the push protection; drop to a lean at +2.5 or on adverse lineup news.
